a great spirit-wolf with softly glowing eyes padding watchfully at her side
a lean grey wolf sitting alert at her flank, ears pricked
a large snowy owl perched on her shoulder, round eyes gleaming
a tawny owl settled on the head of her staff, watching the dark
a young bear ambling close beside her, unhurried and calm
a glossy raven with knowing eyes settled on her shoulder
a proud stag standing at her flank, antlers raised against the trees
a sleek lynx crouched watchful at her feet, tufted ears turning
a red fox trotting quietly alongside her through the brush
a small hawk circling just overhead, catching the light
a translucent moss-antlered spirit-deer drifting half-seen beside her
a pair of glowing blue wisp-lights drifting slowly at her shoulder
